differences.what: The bridge fascia is a bare flat grey box with two blank colored rectangles (blue left, magenta right). In the reference it is a dark wood/charcoal fascia carrying a lit '雫テラス' signboard with a water-drop icon, a pink neon coffee-cup sign, purple wisteria and green vines hanging over the edge, and a cyan neon strip running along the underside.
differences.where: Center, the elevated bridge spanning the road
differences.fix: Replace the blue panel with a warm-lit dark-wood signboard reading '雫テラス' with a white drop icon. Replace the magenta panel with a dark box holding a pink neon coffee-cup outline. Give the fascia a dark brown/charcoal material. Add hanging wisteria clusters and ivy drooping 1-2 m over the front edge, and run a thin emissive cyan strip along the bottom lip.

differences.what: The terrace canopy is missing. The reference has a glass-roofed pergola on top of the bridge with warm string lights, about 8 hanging paper lanterns and a warm glow. The capture shows a few orange umbrellas set far back and dim.
differences.fix: Build a steel-frame pergola with a translucent glass roof spanning the full bridge. Hang catenary strings of warm bulbs (2700K) along the rafters and 6-10 glowing white/peach paper lanterns. It should be the brightest warm element in the upper frame.

differences.what: The convenience-store fascia is wrong. The capture has a red/green/blue 7-Eleven-style stripe with blown-out illegible white text ('AKA MART'-like). The reference has a white sign with a teal band and orange stripe, a yellow star logo and teal 'ほしマート' lettering.
differences.fix: Retexture the fascia white with a teal top band and an orange accent stripe. Add a yellow star icon and 'ほしマート' in teal. Cut the sign emissive by about 60% so the text reads instead of blooming out.

differences.what: The store interior is overexposed flat white with chunky single-color book blocks. The reference shows layered shelves of varied packaged goods, a warm-white ceiling light grid, and posters (a matcha drink) taped on the glass, with readable depth.
differences.fix: Lower the interior exposure/emissive so shelves have shading. Use varied product meshes and atlas textures (boxes, bags, bottles) and add a ceiling panel-light grid. Put 2-3 promotional posters on the lower glass, and add a glass material with faint reflection.

differences.what: The left foreground has no pink 開運 KAIUN neon shopfront. Instead there is a bright white blank wall and a beige box building with a single amber window. Two traffic cones are present that the reference does not have.
differences.fix: Replace the white wall and beige box with a dark multi-storey building whose ground floor is a pink-lit glass shopfront with a pink neon '開運 KAIUN' sign. Remove the traffic cones. Add the tall dark foreground pole at the far left edge.

differences.what: The staircase is dark and bare. In the reference it has warm LED-lit step edges, white paper lanterns on the newel posts, climbing vines, potted plants at the base and a 'テラス席 ↑' chalkboard A-frame.
differences.where: Left-center, staircase up to the bridge
differences.fix: Add a warm emissive strip under each tread nose. Place 3 glowing paper lanterns with drop icons on the railing posts, ivy along the stringer, and 3-4 potted plants at the foot. Add the black A-frame sign reading 'テラス席 ↑'.

differences.what: Road reflections are wavy, rippling squiggles over a near-black mirror, which looks like a water surface. The reference shows long, straight vertical streaks broken by fine bump detail, plus a visible asphalt texture, white lane lines and a crosswalk.
differences.fix: Replace the wave/ripple normal with a fine asphalt normal and puddle mask. Use roughness about 0.15-0.3 so reflections stretch vertically and stay straight. Show the asphalt albedo between puddles, and add a dashed center line, a solid edge line and a crisp crosswalk.

differences.what: The color temperature and mood are cold and grey-blue overall. The reference is dominated by a warm orange key (sodium streetlamp, lanterns, shop glow) contrasting with pink and cyan neon.
differences.where: Whole frame, especially left and center
differences.fix: Change the streetlamp head to a warm sodium (~2200K) with a visible glow cone. Raise the warm point lights under the bridge and along the street. Reduce the cool ambient/fog and add mild bloom on warm sources, aiming for an orange/pink/teal palette rather than blue-grey.

differences.what: The support pillar and bridge are untextured, smooth grey with a flat shade. The reference pillar is weathered wet concrete with stains, vertical rain streaks and specular sheen.
differences.where: Right-center, the big pillar and bridge underside
differences.fix: Apply a wet concrete material with grime and streak albedo variation, a normal map and a wetness-driven roughness drop. Add damp darkening at the base and a subtle reflection of the store light on its right face.

differences.what: The rain and background are off. Rain is rendered as large chunky square sprites, sparse and bright against the sky. The vertical tower sign is a blank cyan glow instead of pink neon '茶房雫'. A stray thin cyan vertical line cuts the sky. The street depth lacks the row of warm streetlights and lit storefronts. The umbrella stand with clear umbrellas by the store is missing.
differences.where: Upper sky, top-center tower, far background street, right sidewalk by store
differences.fix: Use thin, motion-blurred streak particles at higher density and lower opacity. Change the tower sign to pink neon with the characters 茶房雫 stacked vertically, and remove the cyan line artifact. Line the far street with warm lamps and lit shopfronts receding into haze. Place an umbrella stand with clear umbrellas beside the store entrance.
